rows.text:
1 Peasant builds a Silo then go on Food
1 Peasant build a House, then on Food
Kuafu makes a Silo then goes on Gold

rows.note: Once you have 250 Gold move Kuafu to Wood (build Silo)
Gold Kuafu builds Temple when you have 150 Wood

rows.text:
At 400 Food: transition:
3 Food Peasants  to Gold
3 Food Peasants to Wood

3 Peasant to Food
When enough resources: 
1 Gold Kuafu + 1 Wood Kuafu walk to second TC 
(after that: one to Wood, one to Gold)

1 Kuafu on Gold
Vills transition:
2 Gold Peasants build 2 farms after 200 Gold (needed for Kuafu)
1 Gold Peasant to Wood
 CAST PROSPEROUS SEEDS

1 TC: 2 Kuafu on Gold + 1 Peasant on Food
1 TC: Peasants on Food
rows.note:
Gold Kuafu makes Armory, then bck to Gold
2 Wood Peasants make Farm + CAST PROSPEROUS SEEDS
Food Peasant build House, then back to Food
2 Food Peasants make Farm + CAST PROSPEROUS SEEDS

rows.text:
1 TC: Peasants to food
2 TC: Kuafu to Gold (alternate with Wood when needed, Peasants when not enough Favor)
rows.note:
Gold Kuafu makes Baolei, then back to Gold
Wood Kuafu makes House, then back to Wood
